music-theory-for-worshippers.excerpt: A simple, worship-focused course — from why contemporary worship music is deliberately simple to the physics behind the twelve-tone system.

getting-started.title: Getting Started with Worship Viewer
getting-started.excerpt: Create your first song, build a set, and go live in under ten minutes.

sections.heading: Create an account
sections.body: Head to the app and sign up with your email. Once you are in, create or join a team so charts and sets stay in sync for everyone.

sections.heading: Add your first song
sections.body: Import from ChordPro or Ultimate Guitar, or build a chart from scratch. Pick the key, add sections, and Worship Viewer keeps every part aligned.

sections.heading: Build a set and go live
sections.body: Drag songs into a set list, reorder as needed, and open the live view when worship starts. Every musician sees the chart they need — you stay focused on the room.

hero.title: Helps you lead worship - then steps aside when the Spirit takes over.
hero.subtitle: Focus on the room not the screen! Don't make music - worship!

planning.caption: Manage and display every chart in any key, so every worshipper sees the part they need instantly.

singleSource.title: Single Source of Truth
singleSource.description: Craft a song once, then trust it everywhere—charts, slides, clicks, cues, and every team member stay perfectly in sync.

preparedYetFree.title: Prepared Yet Free
preparedYetFree.description: Plan sets down to the beat, but break out the instant the Spirit leads—even launch fully spontaneous worship without losing footing.

allForHisGlory.title: All for His Glory
allForHisGlory.description: The whole purpose of this App is to worship and glorify the one true God - The Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit.

support.title: Join the Mission to Serve Worshippers
